title: › Uncover driving forces
content: Home | Solution | Insight | Uncover Driving Forces Insight Uncover the Driving Forces See which raw materials, process settings, and molecular features are driving final properties. Faster Understanding For Product Experts Give product experts a faster way to understand what is driving outcomes, build confidence in AI predictions, and make stronger technical recommendations. Raw Materials Identify which ingredients have the greatest influence on formulation performance and by how much. Processing Parameters Understand how process settings shape final properties across your development pipeline. Molecular Features Reveal how chemical and molecular characteristics affect performance outcomes. Feature importance and feature impact plots in the Citrine Platform help teams see which raw materials, processing parameters, and molecular features affect formulation performance — by how much, and in which direction. Turn AI Output Into Usable Insight These views help teams move beyond prediction alone. Scientists can see which factors are influencing final properties, whether those factors improve or reduce performance, and how much of a material is needed before it has a meaningful effect. That makes it easier to: Focus Experiments Direct resources toward the variables that matter most, reducing wasted trials. Simplify Formulations Eliminate ingredients with minimal impact and streamline your product recipes. Understand Trade-Offs See the competing forces shaping product behavior and make informed compromises. “By analyzing feature importance, we quickly identified which ingredients actually mattered and eliminated those with minimal impact. That allowed us to focus our exploration, streamline our formulations, and dramatically improve development efficiency.” — Head of Innovation and Advanced Materials, Adhesives company Support Stronger Technical Recommendations For specialty chemical companies, feature insight is especially valuable when working directly with OEM customers. Evidence-based conversations are more credible and more persuasive. When teams can show how ingredient loading, coating thickness, adhesive thickness, or process settings affect performance, they are in a much stronger position to justify recommendations to OEM customers. The conversation becomes more evidence-based and more credible. Ingredient Loading Quantify the effect of concentration on performance to guide precise formulation decisions. Coating Thickness Show customers exactly how dimensional parameters translate to measurable outcomes. Process Settings Demonstrate the impact of manufacturing conditions on final product specifications. Adhesive Thickness Link structural parameters to performance metrics with AI-backed precision. Build Trust in What the AI is Learning Product experts value this capability because it helps them see that the platform is learning scientifically meaningful relationships. When the important features align with known chemistry, process knowledge, or plausible mechanisms, it reassures teams that the system is working as intended. It also helps them discover new things about their domain — surfacing relationships that weren’t previously visible through traditional experimentation alone. “We have insights that we gain with AI that we wouldn’t have otherwise.” — David Thomas – Director of Research Development, Syensqo Help Experts Learn Faster This is one of the most appreciated parts of the platform because it deepens domain understanding while accelerating development. Feature importance doesn’t just speed up the current project. It builds lasting expertise that compounds over time. “We get a better understanding of our domain itself.” — Florian – Application Engineer, Gebrüder Dorfner GmbH & Co.
